title: Houston bounded archival aerial display references
sourcePeriod: CONUS NAIP 2017–2021, as reported in service metadata; exact acquisition date per pixel is not supplied by this export
license: Public-domain CONUS USGS/USDA imagery. Retain source attribution. Alaska/Hawaii exceptions do not apply to this Houston extract.
purpose: Visualization only. Not current conditions, training data, terrain, flood depth, road condition or asset damage evidence.
derivation: Two bounded WGS84 JPEG service exports re-encoded to WebP quality 68 using Pillow. Raw service downloads are not committed. No visual content was added or removed.
limitations: Mixed dates and resolution; regional source includes some no-data areas around the bay.
Ellipsoid display without a measured elevation model; tilt does not imply modeled terrain or buildings.
Road graph, storm tracks and flood footprints are separate labeled project-generated hypothetical geometry.
